desc: Upgraded ergonomics make the FN 545 MRD a pleasure to handle, merging class-leading shootability with stopping power. Built with enduring accuracy in mind, shooters can mount their favorite red dot sight in minutes, adding pinpoint control on command. Complete with the high endurance striker and crisp, ≈6-lb. trigger pull, the FN 545 MRD is what other big bore pistols want to be when they grow up.
